requiredFindings.title: Account for C1c-0 evidence retention in its own charge model
requiredFindings.detail: LD-C1C-13:171-175 now assigns C1c-0 the charged WalkEvidence return and charged retention of the walk's member roots. These run as part of CaptureSession::walk, on the snapshot ledger, even before C1c-1 exists. At the declared base, snapshot_walk.rs keeps only the incremental known Cargo-root set and removes entries on frame exit (:225-226); it returns only SnapshotWalkReport. Retaining the complete Cargo-root evidence and member-root set is a new storage/ownership obligation. Yet LD-C1C-9:138 still requires only pin regeneration and claims C1c-0 adds no snapshot-ledger charge because C2 captures use their caller's ledger. That explanation does not cover the changed snapshot walk. LD-C1C-8 prices the evidence only in C1c-1's later term and gate. Thus the plan gives C1c-0 contradictory pricing duties and can leave its native/model soundness and cap evidence stale until a later unit.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Resolve the ownership and charge change before C1c-0 acceptance. If retention adds charges, C1c-0 must own the corresponding model/anchor changes, regenerated soundness vectors and applicable r9 fixed-cap evidence, plus its recipe/pin receipt impact. C1c-1 then extends that accepted recipe with its own read-set work. If an implementation can instead retain everything by already-priced moves/borrows with zero incremental charge, specify that mechanism and require an exact charge/model equivalence control in C1c-0; do not simultaneously promise new charged retention and pins-only changes. Update the split, LD-C1C-8/9/13 and checks consistently.

requiredFindings.title: Allow rows authorized by overlapping layout directories
requiredFindings.detail: The new allocation-free guard requires each ReadSet row to lie below exactly one retained admitted realPath. Neither the layout schema nor IE:567-583 requires the directory set to be prefix-free; IE authorizes a row through a qualifying listed prefix. The plan itself prices traversal of overlapping directories at LD-C1C-8:120. For retained realPaths node_modules/a and node_modules/a/subpackage, the row node_modules/a/subpackage/x.ts lies below both, and neither relative suffix crosses another node_modules segment. It is a permitted read, reused once by the session, but the new exactly-one guard rejects it as Internal. Identical-path deduplication does not eliminate these distinct overlapping prefixes. Round two's guard required a qualifying layout row, not unique coverage.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Require at least one eligible retained authorization satisfying the suffix and exclusion rules. Alternatively assign each row a deterministic unique authorization during charged preparation without rejecting otherwise permitted overlapping directories, and check that assignment at sealing. Preserve the per-layout-row manifest digest joins and single capture. Add an overlapping-realPath control where both prefixes qualify and the shared file is inventoried once, plus the existing nested-node_modules negative and separately authorized positive controls.
